slides.heading: Generate Div Tags
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Recursion
slides.narration: Let's solve Generate Div Tags, a hard recursion problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets:
All valid strings of n matched
pairs (balanced-parentheses generation).
slides.narration: Here's the problem. All valid strings of n matched under div over under /div over pairs (balanced-parentheses generation).

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Backtracking: you can open a tag while some remain and close one only if more are open than closed.
slides.narration: Backtracking: you can open a tag while some remain and close one only if more are open than closed.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Generate all 2^(2n) strings and filter → O(4ⁿ·n)
Output size is the Catalan number
slides.narration: Generating every string and filtering valid ones is wasteful. Backtracking with remaining counts only builds valid prefixes; the output size is the Catalan number.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 1. Track opening and closing tags left
2. Add an opening tag if available
3. Add a closing tag if it keeps balance
slides.narration: Step by step. First, track opening and closing tags left. Second, add an opening tag if available. Third, add a closing tag if it keeps balance. Fourth, record complete strings.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: Two rules keep tags valid
slides.narration: Track how many opening and closing tags remain. Open if any opens remain; close only if more closes than opens remain.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: Depth-first: open, open, open, close…
slides.narration: Depth first, we open three times, then close three times: the first answer.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: n = 3 → 5 combinations
slides.narration: Backtracking yields all 5 valid combinations, shown here with angle brackets for div tags.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: Gen records the string when no closes remain. It appends an opening tag if opens remain and recurses, and a closing tag if closes exceed opens, undoing each append.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of Catalan(n) times n. Space is O of Catalan(n) times n.

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
slides.narration: Only close when more closes than opens remain.

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: Backtracking: you can open a tag while some remain and close one only if more are open than closed.
slides.narration: To recap Generate Div Tags: Backtracking: you can open a tag while some remain and close one only if more are open than closed. Try re-implementing it from scratch without looking.
